title: When the Passage Wakes
author: Emrys Halloran
blurb: Coral Zhou, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
